title: Native editing and context history
steps: Click immediately before Alpha in View A and type LOCAL. Confirm View B shows it after durable acceptance.
Use Close/reopen A once, return to A and press Command-Z, then Shift-Command-Z.
expected: LOCAL disappears/reappears in both views. History survives actual view destruction and foreign/headless text remains.

title: Targeted table keyboard/focus
steps: Click inside Four. Press Tab at the final cell; it stays there. Shift-Tab reaches Three with the caret at its text end.
Press Escape, then Tab: highlight moves without a caret. Enter resumes editing. Add a row with its handle.
expected: Confirmed modes and table boundaries hold; adding a row preserves original cell, caret/selection and focus. No automatic row growth.

title: Failed save and native close protection
steps: Enable Fail saves, type PROTECTED in A, then enable Fail protection.
Click the red window-close button. It must remain open with typed text. Disable Fail protection, then close the window again and use Experiment → Reopen window.
expected: Failed protection blocks real native window close. Successful protection precedes close. Reopened views explicitly load protected state; no silent stale overwrite. Disable Fail saves and Resume A to save.

title: Owner restart and app-closed continuity
steps: Use Pause A, type RESTART, then Protect pending. Click Crash/reconnect and then Resume A.
Confirm both views converge, quit with Command-Q, then run the printed packaged CLI read command.
expected: Owner restarts with durable content/protection and an explicit interactive-history boundary. Pending text remains available. CLI still reads the same Space without the desktop process.
